content.concept_description: A 3D meerkat made of maze blocks transitions into a 2D arrow maze puzzle where arrows are systematically untangled and cleared.
content.why_it_works: The hypnotic, rhythmic clearing of intricate arrow paths creates a calm, satisfying loop that draws puzzle fans in.

visuals.notable_objects: Interlocking white arrows, animated pointer hand

emotions.emotional_arc: Curious 3D intro -> satisfying and relaxing puzzle solving

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: A simulated hand taps free outward-pointing arrows to shoot them off the board and gradually clear the meerkat-shaped maze.

chapterization.chapter_description: 3D rotating meerkat composed of maze blocks.
Continuous gameplay of tapping free arrows to clear the meerkat silhouette.
